findings: The frozen success thresholds were honestly satisfied.
The selected rule was DEPTH_LT_3, not an exponent-4-sensitive rule.
The result has zero false positives on held-out but 72 false negatives, corresponding to fourth-power-free numbers rejected because they are not cubefree.
Balanced accuracy alone was insufficient to require exact symbolic semantics for a deterministic characteristic function.

protocolImprovement.law: For deterministic finite symbolic targets where an exact characteristic function is claimed, exact held-out semantics must be a promotion gate in addition to predictive metrics.
protocolImprovement.minimumForm: Track generic maximum prime exponent to a declared cap and expose generic threshold predicates DEPTH_LT_K / DEPTH_GE_K over multiple K values.
protocolImprovement.antiLeakage: Threshold family must be declared generically before the result and must not contain target names.
